title: NASA announcement of possible life on Mars

tellings.quote: the the NASA just recently announced that they found some sort of life on Mars.

plain: NASA recently announced it had found "some sort of life on Mars", according to Dan Sherman, a former sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens. Sherman mentions it to Michels in passing in 2025 and gives no detail of the announcement. If so, it would be the first official word of life beyond Earth.
